# iClock

> Ultra-lightweight (222 KB), zero-dependency, click-through desktop countdown timer and AI agent task monitor for Windows.

iClock is an open-source, minimalist Windows desktop floating countdown timer designed for deep focus and productivity. It compiles to a single 222 KB native portable executable with zero runtime dependencies.

## Key Specifications

- **Application Category**: Desktop Utility, Focus & Pomodoro Countdown Timer, AI Agent Completion Monitor
- **Architecture**: Pure C# WinForms (.NET Framework 4.x runtime, built into Windows 10/11)
- **Binary Size**: ~222 KB single file, portable (no installation required)
- **Memory Footprint**: < 15 MB static RAM
- **Operating System Compatibility**: Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11
- **Display Mode**: Floating desktop text with native click-through (`WS_EX_TRANSPARENT`)
- **Global Hotkey**: Configurable system-wide toggle (default: `Ctrl+Shift+T`)
- **Default Appearance**: Font size 20 px, Red text (`#FF0000`)
- **Supported Formats**: `HH:MM:SS`, `MM:SS`, and localized time units (`00时25分00秒` / `00h 25m 00s`)
- **License**: MIT License (100% free and open-source)
- **Privacy & Safety**: 0 Ads, zero bundled software, zero background telemetry

## Download & Installation

- **Windows Package Manager (WinGet)**:
  ```powershell
  winget install FrancoDeyvison.iClock
  ```
- **Scoop Package Manager**:
  ```powershell
  scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/francodeyvison183-collab/iClock/main/scoop/iclock.json
  ```
- **Official Website**: https://francodeyvison183-collab.github.io/iClock/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/francodeyvison183-collab/iClock
- **Latest Release (v1.04)**:
  - Standalone Executable: https://github.com/francodeyvison183-collab/iClock/releases/download/1.04/iClock-1.04-windows.exe
  - Portable ZIP Archive: https://github.com/francodeyvison183-collab/iClock/releases/download/1.04/iClock-1.04-windows.zip
  - SHA-256 (EXE): `0eb6232787f6bcd91504e9a3026a4e9b6b0c2a77f480b77b69729876f708c234`
  - SHA-256 (ZIP): `be47d5083c7949fcbb56e1ed56021062ba066741df4484bae79bb3c591d7c0cf`

## Core Differentiators

1. **Native Lightweight vs Electron Bloat**: While typical modern desktop timers consume 150 MB~400 MB of RAM with hundreds of megabytes in download size, iClock requires only ~222 KB on disk and less than 15 MB of RAM.
2. **True TopMost & Click-Through**: Remains visible over full-screen IDEs, games, or presentation software without capturing or blocking mouse clicks.
3. **AI Agent Background Collaboration**: Monitors 20+ domestic and international AI coding agents (Cursor, Antigravity, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Trae, Tongyi Lingma, CodeGeeX, MiniMax, CodeBuddy, etc.) via a 4-tier perception engine (Toast, Win32 Shell taskbar flash at 0ms, window title state badge, and edge-detected cluster CPU fallback) with instant alert and 1-click window restore.
4. **Instant Global Hotkey**: Start or pause countdown anywhere without switching active windows.
5. **Daily Focus History**: Right-click the system tray to review completed, reset, or interrupted countdown records for the day.
